name: Atlas Operations — Product Launch [DEMO]
description: FICTIONAL QA WORKSPACE. Explore Niyarvo Projects v0.3.2 features: Kanban, tasks, nested hierarchy, Gantt, dependencies, scheduling, verification, releases, sprints, burndown, custom fields, saved views, automations, JSON import/export. No real accounts or customer data.

phases.name: Discovery & charter
phases.goal: Validate users, scope, and the delivery hypothesis.
phases.exit: Approved product brief and release gates.

phases.name: Experience & design
phases.goal: Translate discovery into usable responsive workflows.

phases.name: Platform foundation
phases.goal: Establish core identity, data and operational reliability.
phases.exit: Passing local smoke tests with backups.

phases.name: Workflow automation
phases.goal: Deliver project task flows and reliable actions.
phases.exit: Kanban, task engine, and automation acceptance.

phases.name: Collaboration & docs
phases.goal: Deliver task context and usable documentation.

phases.name: Quality & release
phases.goal: Verify quality, recovery and controlled rollout.

phases.name: Portfolio reporting
phases.goal: Make delivery progress visible across projects.

releases.name: Research foundation (demo)
releases.notes: Fictional release checkpoint: all linked discovery tasks have synthetic passing evidence and merge flags.

releases.name: Core product (QA)
releases.notes: Tasks from design, platform, and task workflow stages.

releases.name: Private beta
releases.notes: Gantt, collaboration, QA and launch preparation.

playbooks.name: Sprint review checklist
playbooks.description: Review recorded burndown; inspect unfinished scope; capture follow-up items; finish sprint only after summary signoff.
